questions.q: A man leaves his house, walks 10 m east, turns right and walks 5 m, then turns right again and walks 10 m. Where is he in relation to his house?
questions.why: He goes 10 m east, 5 m south and 10 m back west, ending 5 m south of the house.

questions.q: If FOREST is written as IRUHVW in a certain code, how is PENCIL written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 3 places forward: PENCIL → SHQFLO. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The sum of the ages of a father and his son is 60 years. The father is 40 years older than the son. What are their ages?
A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. How is A related to D?
questions.why: A is the daughter of C, and C is the daughter of D, so A is D's granddaughter.

questions.q: Ramesh walks 9 km towards the north, turns right and walks 12 km. How far is he from his starting point in a straight line?
questions.why: The two legs are at right angles, so the distance is the hypotenuse: the square root of 81 + 144 = 225, which is 15 km.
